posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI ‘teammate’ just outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research TechCrunch AI · 🟧 Claude · 🟢 ChatGPT · 🔵 Gemini · 5h ago • Inherent's Faraday AI agent outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI models at replicating scientific research papers. • The system may advance scientific innovation by automating research paper reproduction tasks. • British lab Inherent was founded by former DeepMind researchers.
